verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a Sandbox mode with a fixed set of test inputs that deterministically produce successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks, and it supports creating custom test users in Sandbox. The evidence covers only the pass path; nothing shows documented values that deterministically trigger fail or manual-review outcomes. Missing for 10: documented magic values for fail and review outcomes, coverage of other checks (liveness, risk checks), independent or hands-on corroboration.
